title: The New Desk and the Red Cup · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about your desk or table. Use this, that, he, she, it, is, a, an. Example: This is my desk. It is near a window. A red cup is on it.
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
